stem:
This is a map of Lucy’s town. The market is at the position C2.

[Image: a map with x-axis labeled A through I from left to right and the y-axis labeled 1 through 8 from down to up.]

B. Lucy’s house is at D5. Put an X on the map to show where Lucy’s house is.

descriptors: Cross or other mark anywhere in square D5
Incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: A grid of 9 columns and 8 rows of square cells. The columns are labeled along the bottom from left to right with uppercase letters A through I, and the rows are labeled along the left side from bottom to top with numbers 1 through 8. Inside three of the cells are labels centered within the squares: cell C2 contains the word "market", cell F6 contains the word "school", and cell H3 contains the word "shop". All other cells in the grid are blank.
